title: How to Play
text: Core loop: GM frames, players describe intent, dice settle uncertain outcomes.

title: Dice Basics
text: Percentile dice read 00–99; tens die first; d6 and d10 used for damage.

title: When to Roll the Dice
text: Roll only when failure matters and the outcome is uncertain or contested.

title: Making Tests
text: Roll d100 at or under skill plus modifiers to succeed.

title: Who Rolls?
text: Players roll for their characters; GM rolls for NPCs and hidden checks.

title: Criticals
text: Rolling doubles is a critical; 00 always crit-succeeds, 99 always crit-fails.

title: Difficulty and Modifiers
text: Situational modifiers shift the target in steps of 10; cumulative total capped at ±60.

title: Defaulting
text: Without the skill, test against its linked aptitude value instead.

title: Superior Results: 33/66 Rule
text: Successful rolls over 33 or 66 earn one or two superior results.

title: Teamwork
text: Each helper with the skill adds +10, up to +30 total.

title: Types of Tests
text: Two test kinds: solo success tests and head-to-head opposed tests.

title: Success Tests
text: Unopposed roll against a target number; margin and superiors shape the outcome.

title: Automatic Actions
text: Always-on actions that cost nothing and need no decision.

title: Quick Actions
text: Minor actions: three per turn, or one alongside a complex or task action.

title: Opposed Tests
text: Both sides roll; if both succeed, the higher roll wins.

title: Complex Actions
text: One focused action per turn, such as an attack.

title: Task Actions
text: Multi-turn jobs with a listed timeframe to finish.

title: Actions & Time
text: Time units for play: turns, action types, and longer task timeframes.

title: Taking Time
text: Spend extra time on a task to gain a bonus.

title: Action Turns
text: A turn is about three seconds; choose a complex, task or quick-action combo.

title: Rushing the Job
text: Finish faster by accepting a penalty on the test.

title: Initiative & Order of Actions
text: Turn order: roll Initiative each turn, act from highest to lowest.

title: Initiative Order
text: Initiative score plus a d6 roll sets who acts first.

title: Taking the Initiative
text: Spend Vigor, or Insight for purely mental actions, to act first.

title: Delaying Actions
text: Hold your action to act later in the same turn.

title: Extra Actions
text: Speed-boosting effects grant additional action phases per turn.

title: Moxie
text: Social and willpower pool; also helps resist stress.

title: Pools
text: Spendable points (Insight, Moxie, Vigor, Flex) that boost or alter rolls.

title: Vigor
text: Physical pool for combat, athletics and resisting wounds.

title: Using Pools
text: Spend a point for +20, a flipped roll, or an upgraded result.

title: Flex
text: Ego-based wild pool usable on any test or to edit the scene.

title: Insight
text: Mental pool for cognitive, perception and tech tests.

title: Recharging Pools
text: Short rest (10 min, twice daily) restores some; long rest (4 h, daily) restores all.

title: Temporary Pools
text: Bonus points from drugs, gear or effects that expire.

Resolving Combat
text: Nine-step sequence for resolving any attack.

title: Step 1: Declare Attack
text: Attacker states target and attack method.

title: Step 2: Declare Defense
text: Defender chooses how to resist the attack.

title: Step 3: Apply Modifiers
text: Add situational modifiers to both sides.

title: Step 4: Make Opposed Test
text: Attacker and defender roll against each other.

title: Step 5: Determine Result
text: Higher success hits; superiors raise damage.

title: Step 6: Roll Damage
text: Roll the weapon's damage dice and add bonuses.

title: Step 7: Apply Armor
text: Subtract the matching armor value from damage.

title: Step 9: Determine Wounds
text: Compare damage to wound threshold to find wounds.
